usage: SelectQual.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] --output_fn OUTPUT_FN
                     [--var_pct_full VAR_PCT_FULL]
                     [--ref_pct_full REF_PCT_FULL]
                     [--var_pct_phasing VAR_PCT_PHASING] [--phase]
                     [--vcf_fn VCF_FN]

Select quality cut-off for phasing and full alignment

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --output_fn OUTPUT_FN
                        Define the output folder, required
  --var_pct_full VAR_PCT_FULL
                        Specify an expected percentage of low quality 0/1 and
                        1/1 variants called in the pileup mode for full-
                        alignment mode calling, default: 0.3
  --ref_pct_full REF_PCT_FULL
                        Specify an expected percentage of low quality 0/0
                        variants called in the pileup mode for full-alignment
                        mode calling, default: 0.3 for ilmn and hifi, 0.1 for
                        ont
  --var_pct_phasing VAR_PCT_PHASING
                        Specify an expected percentage of high quality 0/1
                        variants used in WhatsHap phasing, default: 0.8 for
                        ont guppy5 and 0.7 for other platforms
  --phase               Select only heterozygous candidates for phasing or
                        not, default: False
  --vcf_fn VCF_FN       Candidate sites VCF file input, if provided, variants
                        will only be called at the sites in the VCF file,
                        default: None
